quotes.text: I did a show in Cincinnati once — full house, roaring, everything going great — and I look down and my fly has been open since the hotel lobby. The whole damn drive over. I said to the audience, 'Everything you need to know about me is right there. Front row got the best seats in the house.'

quotes.text: I'll tell you what, the rider at Knebworth said 'no brown M&Ms' and I thought, brilliant, finally someone's read our contract. Then I walked backstage and there's a fucking fruit bowl. A FRUIT BOWL. I threw it at the promoter's assistant and asked her if she'd like to shove a banana where the sun don't shine. She laughed. We got on great after that.
quotes.speaker: John Bonham
quotes.context: Melody Maker, backstage interview, Knebworth Festival, August 1979
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Bonham's volatile, earthy temper and Knebworth '79 are both real, so the setting holds up. The giveaway is the 'no brown M&Ms' rider detail, which was Van Halen's clause, not Led Zeppelin's.
